entries.what: Jun tells Beatrice at Heron & Grind he is dropping to four opener shifts a week, Tuesday to Friday, so weekends are free for Lola's Roll. Monday is now his day off, so he spends it prepping at home.
entries.outcome: Beatrice agrees to the new schedule, effective today.

entries.what: Doing the math at the kitchen table, Jun realizes the dropped shift cuts into his $950 rent money and asks the assistant how to make up the difference.
entries.outcome: Sketches a rough budget and decides to count on more market sales.

entries.what: Evening wrapper run at Ruiz Family Market, aisle 6, for the week's batches.
entries.outcome: Buys two cases and keeps the receipts for Linh's sheet.

entries.what: Veterans Day: the cafe runs a light morning, but Jun is off on Tuesday only in the sense of a slow rush. He pulls his opener shift at Heron & Grind while the bandstand ceremony at Delgado Park draws the crowd away.
entries.outcome: Quiet shift; Wes still gets his 7 a.m. cortado.

entries.what: After work Jun rolls lumpia with Tess at her house off Vinca, with OPM ballads playing.
entries.outcome: Tess's knee complains but they finish a tray of 100.

entries.what: Jun texts Paolo to confirm Saturday counter and Sunday market plans.
entries.outcome: Paolo replies with a thumbs up and no details.

entries.what: Opener shift at Heron & Grind. Jun makes a note about Wes saying the cortado tasted flat.
entries.outcome: Plans to adjust the bean dial-in later.

entries.what: On his break Jun asks the assistant to help write a cheerful Thanksgiving preorder post; when asked about collecting sales tax he says he'll do the tax part later.
entries.outcome: Gets a post draft, parks the tax question.

entries.what: Evening at the commissary-adjacent prep, he counts wrapper stock and updates his preorder list with Tess's coworker orders from the fridge.
entries.outcome: Tally reaches 8 dozen.

entries.what: First fall storm: Jun drives to the cafe through rain on a flooded Ruel Road edge and arrives late for his opener.
entries.outcome: Beatrice waves it off; the morning is slow.

entries.what: Between rushes he sips a double ristretto and practices a tulip-rosetta stack with Linh watching.
entries.outcome: Linh pours a decent rosetta on her own.

entries.what: Rain cancels his plan to prep outside; he stays home and rolls filling in the kitchen.
entries.outcome: Gets 60 lumpia done before dinner.

entries.what: Storm continues; opener shift at Heron & Grind with a damp, busy crowd.
entries.outcome: Sam texts about swapping Saturday; Jun says no this time.

entries.what: Friday 5-9 p.m. commissary block at Ruel Road; Jun fries and packs while the lot floods outside, then scrubs the fryer area so Joan's fee doesn't apply.
entries.outcome: No $40 fee; 300 lumpia frozen and packed.

entries.what: Late dinner of al pastor from Taquería Colima on the way home.
entries.outcome: Eats in the car with the slow window cracked.

entries.what: Saturday table at Heron & Grind: Jun sells lumpia at the end of the counter, and Wes buys two and pays in quarters.
entries.outcome: Sells out of the 150 batch by noon.

entries.what: Jun sends Paolo a set 7 a.m. call time for tomorrow's market setup, without softening it or apologizing.
entries.outcome: Paolo answers 'ok' and says he'll be there.

entries.what: Evening labeling and packing for tomorrow's stall at home.
entries.outcome: Cooler loaded; early bedtime.

entries.what: Sunday market at Delgado Park under his canopy in row C near the bandstand; Paolo shows up on time and runs setup and Instagram.
entries.outcome: Brisk sales through the morning.

entries.what: Tess stops by the stall, tries a lumpia and says nothing about the wrappers, which Jun reads as high praise; he tells the assistant later.
entries.outcome: Jun takes it as approval and grins through the afternoon.

entries.what: Wraps up the stall, tallies sales into Linh's sheet and sends Linh a thank-you text.
entries.outcome: Totals logged; leftover lumpia go to the freezer.
